title: IndustReal rubber-band car assembly · dataset-grounded candidate SOP

approval.reason: The official dataset defines component states and completed-step labels, but it is not a factory work instruction and does not certify safety, torque, or recovery actions.

execution_policy.note: The front- and rear-chassis branches may be completed in either order. After both chassis branches are complete, the front-wheel and rear-wheel branches may also be completed in either order.

source_documents.use: Official step IDs, names, component-state indexes, and assembly membership.
Official component names, state vectors, and valid partial assembly states.

evaluation_sources.use: Held-out evaluation only; never an inference input.
Held-out action-context evaluation only; never an inference input.

visual_reference_policy.note: Embedded component illustrations extracted from the cited SOP-side state overview may clarify terminology during research inference. They are not camera annotations, completion labels, or approved factory teach-in photos.

steps.instruction: Install the front chassis by fitting the two short white perforated braces to opposite sides of the chassis base.
steps.completion_check: The front chassis is correctly located: both short white perforated braces are attached on opposite sides of the chassis base. If both braces and their connection to the base are not visible, return unknown.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

entities.name: front_chassis_brace
entities.description: One currently handled short white perforated brace; two such braces form the front chassis.

entities.name: chassis_base
entities.description: The central white chassis base that receives the braces.

completion_evidence.description: The front-chassis braces remain at the chassis base across several frames.
A terminal visual check confirms both braces are correctly located on opposite sides of the base.

steps.instruction: Install the front chassis pin through the front chassis connection and fit its visible retaining hardware.
steps.completion_check: The front chassis pin is correctly located through the front chassis connection and its visible retaining hardware is present. Visual verification does not claim fastener tightness or hidden engagement.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.

entities.name: front_chassis

completion_evidence.description: The pin remains at the front-chassis connection across several frames.
A terminal visual check confirms the pin and visible retaining hardware are correctly located.

steps.instruction: Install the rear chassis by fitting the two long white perforated braces to opposite sides of the chassis base.
steps.completion_check: The rear chassis is correctly located: both long white perforated braces are positioned on opposite sides of the chassis base. If the long braces cannot be distinguished from the short front braces, return unknown.
steps.recovery: Hold the procedure and request supervisor review; no unapproved automatic correction is prescribed.
